description_en: This five-bayed Capāḥ belongs to the caste groups of Maharjans and Avale. The roof collapsed due to the Gorkha earthquakes in 2015, and was covered with a replacement zinc sheet until it was dismantled in March 2024. Facing the square towards the south is a three-bayedphalcāwith four recently rennovated columns and a preserved cornice. Until recently, a few struts dating to the 10th century were kept behind it. These struts are now stored inside the Bhelāchẽ Phalcā (LAL4146).
description_ne: पाँचवटा कवल भएको यो चपाः महर्जन र अवाले परिवारको स्वामित्वमा रहेको छ। २०७३ सालको भूकम्पमा यसको छानो खसेको थियो र अहिले (२०७५)  यो जस्तापाताले छाइएको अवस्थामा छ । दक्षिणतर्फ रहेको  प्राङ्गणतर्फ फर्केको फल्चामा तीनवटा कवल र चारवटा  काष्ठस्तम्भ र पुराना दलिन रहेका छन् । यस चपाःको पछाडिपट्टि लगभग १० औँ शताब्दीका जस्ता देखिने केही टुँडालहरू केही समय पहिलासम्म जडिएका देखिन्थे । तर ती  टुँडालहरू अहिले भेलाछेँ फल्चा (LAL4146) भित्र सुरक्षित राखिएका छन् ।
brick_type: dāci apā (conical veneer brick), mā apā (regular fired brick)
monument_assessment: Heavily damaged (collapsed, demolished, major cracks and structural damages)

historical_events.event_description: The Bhairav Library opened for a time in this Capāḥ. However, it was not used much and was thus closed again.
The roof collapsed during the 2015 earthquakes. The upper floor and roof were then provisionally covered with a zinc sheet.
